questions.question: What is the name of the three-headed dog guarding the trapdoor?
questions.note: Hagrid bought him from a Greek chappie. Fang is Hagrid's other dog, the boarhound.

questions.question: What puts Fluffy to sleep?
questions.note: A harp is playing when they arrive. When it stops, he wakes up.

questions.question: What plant under the trapdoor tightens when you struggle?
questions.note: Hermione knows it. You have to relax, and light drives it back.

questions.question: Who sacrifices himself on the giant chessboard so Harry can go on?
questions.note: Ron plays the knight. He lets the queen take him so Harry can checkmate the king.

questions.question: What does Harry see when he looks into the Mirror of Erised?
questions.note: The mirror shows the deepest desire of your heart.

questions.question: Who created the Sorcerer's Stone?
questions.note: Harry finds the name on a Chocolate Frog card. The British title of the film calls the stone the Philosopher's Stone.

questions.question: What drink made with the Stone keeps the owner alive?
questions.note: Dumbledore and Nicolas later agree to destroy the Stone so Voldemort cannot have it.

questions.question: Who has Voldemort living on the back of his head?
questions.note: The stutter and the turban are a cover. Voldemort's face is underneath.

questions.question: What happens to Quirrell when he touches Harry's skin?
questions.note: Lily's sacrifice protects Harry. Quirrell cannot bear the touch.

questions.question: Whose last-minute points win Gryffindor the House Cup?
questions.note: Ten points for having the nerve to stand up to his friends. Slytherin had been ahead all year.
